blocks.heading: The product offering
blocks.text: A product is the good or service offered to meet a customer need. It includes relevant features, quality, design and supporting service rather than only a physical object. A repair service is a product offering even though the customer is not simply buying a newly manufactured item. Product is distinct from production, the process of creating the offering. Customers judge whether benefits meet their purpose at an acceptable price. A technically impressive feature may add cost without value if buyers do not need it.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Fictional Omi Bags offers a durable tool bag with repair support. Its product includes the bag’s strength, compartments and support. The cutting and sewing process is production, not the name of this marketing-mix element.
